semantic.justification: Represented native RTF export now carries current-model character decoration, links and paragraph indentation; complete upstream responsibilities remain unverified. RTF run collection now borrows actual SwAttrIter/CharFormat item stacks for named and automatic hints. Every represented script font is registered before the font table is serialized; style and run property modes are distinguished. The source RTLAndCJKState consumer is exposed, but complete native MSWord script/bidi production, full font identity/encoding and parser language mapping remain unverified. Native non-associated OutputCharFontAssoc updates the actual RtfExport current encoding through FontMapExport and checked font charset selection, with original unknown-to-default fallback; associated font output leaves encoding unchanged. Native RunText ignores its supplied charset and delegates RawText/OutString using current export encoding. RTF text uses represented GetSnippet substitutions; style names and hyperlink values use OutString. The name-only Map font table is replaced by wwFontHelper with native FFN identity, preserving different metadata for equal family names. The actual export stream is used for native font-table methods and final byte writes; TextEncoder no longer owns RTF byte output. Source InitFontTable seed/order/default and automatic-style usage enumeration remain pending.
